dcterms:title: SMART Trust demonstrator: journeys J1 to J4

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: Birth clinic issuing system
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The hospital system abroad that issues a DVC per dose with the HCERT library: the HCERT issuing system (smart-trust-tools) of a trust network participant (XXR).

**Persona**: Software that calls the library once per dose and never holds the private key; signs only with a DSC its country's CSCA issued and has already shared with the GDHCN.

**Also known as**: Issuer of the birth-dose DVCs (SMART Trust Issuer)

**Played in the journeys by**: Provincial hospital system, Country A (XXR) (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: Birth clinic vaccinator
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The clinician abroad who gives the birth doses and hands over the signed paper DVC (J1).

**Persona**: A maternity-ward clinician who records doses in the hospital system and prints what it produces.

**Played in the journeys by**: Dr Pimchanok WATTANA (birth clinic, abroad) (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: Caregiver
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The parent who holds the child's paper DVCs and the family phone, and presents them; IHE ITI VHL VHL Holder and smart-trust Holder.

**Persona**: A parent carrying a newborn's records across borders on paper and one shared phone; no health training, little time, limited connectivity.

**Also known as**: VHL Holder (IHE ITI VHL); Holder (SMART Trust)

**Played in the journeys by**: Mali SOUVANNALATH (mother) (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: CHW app
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The OHS app on the CHW's phone: reads a foreign DVC without verifying it (triage read, STT-VER-011), registers the child and records a referral, all offline, syncing later.

**Persona**: Offline-first Android app; must never present an unverified record as verified.

**Also known as**: Triage reader (SMART Trust Receiver, read-unverified)

**Played in the journeys by**: CHW app, Country B (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: Community health worker
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
Finds unregistered children on home visits, registers them and refers them to the clinic (J2).

**Persona**: Works on foot and offline, on a cheap Android phone; registers and refers, never judges authenticity.

**Played in the journeys by**: Sita RAI (community health worker, home) (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: Family phone
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The one smartphone the family shares, holding one VHL QR per member (J4); holds links, not keys to anyone's records beyond what each link grants.

**Persona**: A shared Android phone, sometimes offline; whoever holds it can show any member's QR, the passcode protects the records.

**Also known as**: Personal health wallet

**Played in the journeys by**: The family's shared phone (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: GDHCN trust anchor
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
WHO's GDHCN, which receives participants' PKI material and distributes it as DID trust lists; Trust Network Anchor (SMART Trust), Trust Anchor (IHE ITI VHL).

**Persona**: A WHO service publishing DID documents over did:web; verifiers fetch it when online and keep a copy.

**Also known as**: Trust Network Anchor (SMART Trust); Trust Anchor (IHE ITI VHL)

**Played in the journeys by**: GDHCN DEV trust network (WHO) (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: Home clinic EHR
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The clinic's OHS-based record system: verifies DVCs against the GDHCN trust list, imports them as FHIR Immunization resources and evaluates the national schedule (J3).

**Persona**: Holds the DID trust list from its last refresh, about weekly for a clinic without its own connection, when the CHW visits the base clinic or district health office; loading it is a precondition of a visit, and it verifies offline at the point of care.

**Also known as**: Verifier at the home clinic (SMART Trust Receiver)

**Played in the journeys by**: Home clinic EHR, Country B (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: Home clinic provider
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The nurse at the home clinic who receives the referral, has the foreign DVCs verified and decides catch-up doses (J3).

**Persona**: Trusts the system's verdict and needs a reason when a certificate fails.

**Played in the journeys by**: Tomas ALVES (nurse, home clinic) (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: Issuer signing key
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The DSC private key of the issuing participant, in an HSM, cloud KMS or Android Keystore; signs the bytes the issuing system prepares (two-phase signing, STT-ISS-004).

**Persona**: A key that signs what it is given and reveals nothing else.

**Also known as**: Document signer (DSC) key

**Played in the journeys by**: XXR document signer key (Country A) (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: National health portal
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The home country's portal that issues each family member's records (IPS, DVCs) as a passcode-protected Verifiable Health Link and hosts the manifests (J4.0): the VHL Sharer.

**Persona**: A government service signing with the national DSC, issued under the national CSCA and already shared with the GDHCN; hosts manifests and encrypted documents for a limited time.

**Also known as**: VHL Sharer (IHE ITI VHL); Issuer of the family's VHLs (SMART Trust Issuer)

**Played in the journeys by**: National health portal, Country B (XXH) (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: Point-of-care provider
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The clinician abroad who scans the family's QR and reads the child's records (J4.1).

**Persona**: Has minutes, no prior relationship with the family, and her own hospital's system.

**Played in the journeys by**: Dr Ana MOREIRA (clinician abroad, J4.1) (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: Point-of-care receiver
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description:
The clinic system abroad that scans a VHL, verifies it, fetches the manifest (ITI-YY5) and decrypts the documents (J4.1): the VHL Receiver.

**Persona**: A hospital system on a trust network with its own receiver key; its DID trust list is a cache refreshed nightly or hourly, loaded before a visit, so it verifies without being online.

**Also known as**: VHL Receiver (IHE ITI VHL); Receiver of the family's VHLs (SMART Trust Receiver)

**Played in the journeys by**: Hospital system abroad (J4.1) (fictional).

schema:hasPart.dcterms:title: SMART Trust demonstrator: journeys J1 to J4
schema:hasPart.dcterms:description: The user journeys of one cross-border family (birth-dose DVCs abroad, CHW triage read, clinic verification and schedule, family VHLs on one phone) as a WHO SMART Guidelines L2 DAK and L3 implementation guide, built on the SMART Trust HCERT libraries.
